visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with dark hair wearing a light blue striped button-down shirt over a white t-shirt speaks directly into a handheld camera in a selfie perspective. He is indoors with a light-colored wall and a painting of a cloud-filled sky behind him. (2) A woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, wearing a similar blue striped blouse, appears next to him. They are both smiling and looking into the lens. (3) The scene shifts to a doorway where the male and female stand side-by-side. The male points at the camera while the female waves. Large yellow and white text overlays appear centrally. (4) The duo performs a series of coordinated gestures: they both mimic holding a phone to their ears with thumb and pinky extended, then attempt to make heart shapes (the male uses his whole hands, the female uses a finger-heart gesture), and finally, they both mock-threaten each other with raised fists while laughing. (5) Transition to a product showcase where two smartphones in decorative cases are held up to a mirror. One case features a white ribbon and rabbit motif; the other has pink roses. The male and female are visible in the mirror's reflection. (6) A series of close-up shots show various tech accessories, including an iPad case with cartoon bear graphics, a black phone case with a rabbit cardholder, and an AirPod case with a bear and ice cream illustration. (7) The male and female return to the indoor setting, sitting together. They hold up the rabbit-themed phone case and point towards it while speaking enthusiastically. The female waves at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal greeting in Mandarin, characterized by a bright pitch and fast speech rate. A jaunty, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 drum machine beat underlies the voice. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the transition as a female voice joins the male. Both voices exhibit high arousal and positive valence, featuring frequent laughter and playful intonation. (3) A series of digital 'bubble pop' and 'whoosh' SFX occur rapidly, marking each new prompt in the challenge sequence. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (4) The audio transitions to a more narrative promotional tone. The male speaker maintains a professional yet enthusiastic delivery, highlighting product features. Synthesized 'sparkle' SFX are layered over the mention of specific designs. (5) The final phase features both voices speaking simultaneously with high pitch variability, promoting a holiday sale. A final 'ding' stinger marks the end of the audio track.
